sources.title: Linzumi product and pricing
sources.finding: macOS Apple Silicon beta and browser workspace. Multiple humans steer concurrent local agents in one thread; inline diffs, replay, previews and exportable artifacts. Personal free solo plan; Company $100/month flat; Enterprise offers SSO/SAML/SCIM and self-hosting.

sources.title: Linzumi Commander CLI README
sources.locator: Try it; Manual Runner Setup; headless auth; MCP; working as a team
sources.finding: Official @linzumi/cli README documents trusted project folders, browser/local separation, Codex launch, headless VPS device-flow authentication, scoped MCP message/thread/channel reads and owner DM; team members can steer and interrupt the same thread.

sources.title: Linzumi CLI release and recovery notes
sources.finding: Latest package 1.0.335 published 2026-11-07. Saved replies recover only after receipt/ownership/archive checks; Ready waits for all recovery obligations. File uploads permit registered Git task worktrees and reject symlink/hidden/unrelated-path escapes.

sources.title: Linzumi C3 roadmap
sources.finding: C3 cited answers, live call transcription, contradiction reconciliation and context-derived verifiable specs are marked Coming soon. No release date stated.

sources.title: Commander native coding engines
sources.locator: npm tarball digest, no gitHead; bundled/minified implementation; VY native execution list; rre SDK loader; SDK query spawn; Bye/zj auth probes
sources.finding: The execution selector admits Codex and Claude Code. The Claude path imports @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk, calls its query with the Claude executable and native settingSources, and accepts native OAuth credentials or provider API keys. The Codex auth path reads the native auth.json OAuth account or OPENAI_API_KEY. Other MCP client configuration formats do not launch additional engines. Inspected the exact published 1.0.340 package, pinned by its npm SHA512 integrity digest rather than a Git revision.

sources.title: Commander independent project issue graph
sources.locator: npm tarball digest, no gitHead; bundled/minified implementation; linzumi_get/create/update_project_task; dependency tools; start_coding_job project_task_id
sources.finding: Registered live MCP handlers create durable project issue/group records with todo/active/blocked/review/done/canceled statuses, descriptions, assignees, priorities and dependency edges. Creation does not start a coding job; explicit start_coding_job binds project_task_id and transitions todo to active. This is native backlog storage separate from coding-session lifecycle. Inspected the exact published 1.0.340 package, pinned by its npm SHA512 integrity digest rather than a Git revision.

sources.title: Commander product-supplied child-job coordinator
sources.locator: npm tarball digest, no gitHead; bundled/minified implementation; linzumi_spawn_child_job; discover_coding_jobs; send_coding_job_message; scoped handler adapters
sources.finding: The product supplies a coding-job coordinator tool that instructs its agent to plan a DAG, spawn durable child jobs under its own job on selected harnesses/models, discover job reports and message workers. Registered handlers dispatch through scoped Linzumi APIs; this is not merely a third-party harness subagent display. Inspected the exact published 1.0.340 package, pinned by its npm SHA512 integrity digest rather than a Git revision.

sources.title: Commander unattended topic checks and wakes
sources.locator: npm tarball digest, no gitHead; bundled/minified implementation; create_topic_wake_subscription; create_topic_check; update/resume subscription handlers
sources.finding: The shipped handlers create standing subscriptions that wake @linzumi when topic entries arrive and scheduled checks that run an argv command on the workspace agent runner. Delivery supports debounce/windows, failure pause and explicit resume. Signed incoming webhook events can feed topics. This is product-owned unattended event/schedule configuration, requiring the associated runner. Inspected the exact published 1.0.340 package, pinned by its npm SHA512 integrity digest rather than a Git revision.

sources.title: Commander PR workflow metadata
sources.locator: npm tarball digest, no gitHead; bundled/minified implementation; linzumi_link_coding_job_pull_request registered handler
sources.finding: The native handler links the active job to a GitHub repository/PR number and URL, stores head/base branches and SHAs, and feeds PR comments, files, commits, checks, deployments and reviews into the job workflow metadata view. This establishes management of an existing PR; it does not claim a native PR-creation command. Inspected the exact published 1.0.340 package, pinned by its npm SHA512 integrity digest rather than a Git revision.

sources.title: Commander package license metadata
sources.finding: The first-party published Commander client package declares MIT. The package does not include a license grant or source distribution for the main hosted Linzumi chat/control-plane service; its client license cannot establish the product-level hosted-core license.
